title: UNI teaching alums recognized with 2026 Yager Exemplary Teaching Award
summary_en: Two UNI teaching alumni earned recognition for their service to the education field when they recently received the University of Northern Iowa Dr. Robert E. and Phyllis M. Yager Exemplary Teaching Recognition Award.
title_cn: UNI teaching alums recognized with 2026 Yager Exemplary Teaching Award

title: Board of Regents approves new 3-year degree at UNI
summary_en: It will be UNI’s first 90-credit bachelor's degree, planned to launch in August 2027, pending approval from the Higher Learning Commission.
title_cn: Board of Regents approves new 3-year degree at UNI

title: A “major” decision: Guiding your teen’s career exploration before college
summary_en: As a parent, you can guide your teen toward a career marked by purpose. Here are some tips to help your teen who might be asking "How do I choose a major?"
